# hetznerrobot_vswitches (Data Source)

Lists the account's vSwitches, cancelled ones included. Read a single one with `hetznerrobot_vswitch` for its servers and subnets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_vswitches" "all" {}

output "active_vlans" {
  value = [for v in data.hetznerrobot_vswitches.all.vswitches : v.vlan if !v.cancelled]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `vswitches` (Attributes List) The vSwitches. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vswitches))

<a id="nestedatt--vswitches"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vswitches`

Read-Only:

- `cancelled` (Boolean) Whether the vSwitch is cancelled.
- `id` (Number) Numeric vSwitch id.
- `name` (String) Name of the vSwitch.
- `vlan` (Number) VLAN id.
